name: Venezuela
notes: National research through R012; regional and municipal records not yet sampled. Geography and map use OCHA/HDX COD-AB Venezuela (INE, valid 2021-02-23; CC BY-IGO). The 2019 Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios is the principal enacted tax. Both pro-government authors and independent left organisations have proposed wealth taxes. The 2018 co-author lists and ANC debate records remain incomplete; positions are not necessarily checked against the official member list.
